summary: Backend-only testing for iteration 33 (Deodap = 3rd data source in Smart Product-Master Search). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iteration33_deodap.py (11 tests, ALL PASSED). Verified: (1) Auth gate returns 401 unauth. (2) q=headphone returns items with BOTH source='91mobiles' AND source='deodap' — m91_hits=4, deodap_hits=10 observed. (3) New response fields m91_hits and deodap_hits present, typed as int, alongside existing local_hits/count/external_used/external_available. (4) Deodap rows carry valid HTTPS image_url (or //cdn.shopify.com), numeric price > 0, source='deodap', and external_url containing 'deodap.in'. (5) Local iPhone product still appears FIRST in merged items[] for q=iphone (before 91mobiles/deodap rows). (6) De-duplication holds — no (normalized name, brand) duplicates across sources on any tested query (headphone/iphone/clock). (7) q=wall+clock → deodap_hits > 0 (Deodap dominates for general merchandise). (8) q=iphone+15+pro+max → 91mobiles rows returned when local hits < 3 (skipped by design if local >= 3). (9) Cache works: cold call ~1246ms (both providers), warm call ~205ms — >5x speedup and merged item list is byte-identical, m91_hits/deodap_hits stable. (10) Regression — GET /api/products/master/91mobiles-specs?name=iPhone+15&brand=Apple still returns 200. (11) Regression — GET /api/products still returns local products; POST /api/vendor/me/products still accepts serial_number/imei_1/imei_2 and persists them through GET.

minor.issue: Zero-result external queries are NOT cached — every repeat call for a query that returned m91=0 AND deodap=0 hits both upstream providers again. Root cause: products_master.py:457 gates the cache write behind `if external_91 or external_deodap`. Impact is small (only affects gibberish queries) but wastes ~1s per repeat + increases risk of upstream rate-limiting. Suggest also caching empty results with a shorter TTL (e.g. 1h) to prevent hammering.

Function docstring at products_master.py:361 still says 'across the LOCAL catalog + 91mobiles autosuggest' — mention of Deodap is missing. Also line 107 in _shape_master_row still comments 'local | 91mobiles' — should include 'deodap'. Purely doc/comment nits, no functional impact.

rca_of_issue: No blocking bugs. During test authoring I initially observed the cache warm call taking ~1100ms (same as cold), traced to my test using a randomised query 'headphoneXXXX' that returned zero external results — the endpoint (correctly per current logic) does not persist an empty result to cache, so both calls hit external. This is a MINOR performance nit reported under backend_issues.minor, not a regression. The retest with q='earphone' (which returns real results) showed the expected warm-cache speedup (cold ~1246ms → warm ~205ms, 6x faster; merged item list byte-identical). Second nit: 91mobiles-specs endpoint requires an explicit `brand=Apple` query param — passing only `name=iPhone 15` returns 404 because the endpoint's brand fallback lowercases the first token ('iphone') which is not a key in _BRAND_URLS. This was noted in iteration 32 tests as well (they always pass brand explicitly), so it is NOT a regression from Deodap changes.
